games.name: [⏰] Grow a Business💸
games.desc:
🏢 Welcome to Grow a Business! 🏢

Are you ready to build your very own business? Hire employees from the Shop when they restock, place them on your plot, wait for them to start working, and collect the cash profits! Flex your earnings and rare employees on friends, and have fun!

[How To Place Employees]
• Equip the Employee tool you want to place!
• Click on your plot's designated area (often green) to place!
• Wait for the placement timer!
• After they're set up, it's time to collect the cash they generate!

Remember, your business literally earns while you are offline⭐
